import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")
sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx/ooxml")

from skills.docx.scripts.document import Document

HEADLINES = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

RPR_ORDER = [
    "w:rStyle", "w:rFonts", "w:b", "w:bCs", "w:i", "w:iCs", "w:caps",
    "w:smallCaps", "w:strike", "w:dstrike", "w:outline", "w:shadow",
    "w:emboss", "w:imprint", "w:noProof", "w:snapToGrid", "w:vanish",
    "w:webHidden", "w:color", "w:spacing", "w:w", "w:kern", "w:position",
    "w:sz", "w:szCs", "w:highlight", "w:u", "w:effect", "w:bdr", "w:shd",
    "w:fitText", "w:vertAlign", "w:rtl", "w:cs", "w:em", "w:lang",
    "w:eastAsianLayout", "w:specVanish", "w:oMath",
]


def add_underline_to_run(run):
    doc = run.ownerDocument
    rpr = None
    for child in run.childNodes:
        if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE and child.tagName == "w:rPr":
            rpr = child
            break
    if rpr is None:
        rpr = doc.createElement("w:rPr")
        run.insertBefore(rpr, run.firstChild)

    for child in list(rpr.childNodes):
        if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE and child.tagName == "w:u":
            rpr.removeChild(child)

    u = doc.createElement("w:u")
    u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")

    # Insert before first existing child that comes after w:u in schema order
    anchor = None
    for child in rpr.childNodes:
        if child.nodeType != child.ELEMENT_NODE:
            continue
        try:
            if RPR_ORDER.index(child.tagName) >= RPR_ORDER.index("w:u"):
                anchor = child
                break
        except ValueError:
            continue
    if anchor is not None:
        rpr.insertBefore(u, anchor)
    else:
        rpr.appendChild(u)


doc = Document("unpacked", rsid="330C3B24")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

for headline in HEADLINES:
    para = editor.get_node(tag="w:p", contains=headline)
    runs = [c for c in para.childNodes
            if c.nodeType == c.ELEMENT_NODE and c.tagName == "w:r"]
    if not runs:
        print(f"WARNING: no runs in paragraph for '{headline}'")
        continue
    for run in runs:
        add_underline_to_run(run)
    print(f"Underlined: {headline} ({len(runs)} run(s))")

doc.save()
print("Saved.")
PYEOF
